node.title: Native Harness post-sentinel pre-readiness exit diagnosis

notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority permitted a provider-free process-free static diagnosis only.
The consumed native attempt remains immutable; no retry, Node, Harness, broker, worker, model, provider or network activity opened during diagnosis.
No product, data, deployment, Pages or protected-ref authority opened.

decisions.summary: Accept the mounted headless-startup missing-task rejection and appExit-one shutdown path as sufficient to explain the retained post-sentinel exit.
Keep the consumed process terminal immutable and perform no digest-oracle reconstruction of destroyed raw streams.
Permit a separately frozen one-process provider-free sentinel-readiness proof with exactly one inert task and the headless runner disabled.
Accept three corrected observations with none open.

claim_scope: The frozen boot passed zero inner task arguments while the exact headless-startup provider remained mounted.
The exact rc7 startup, Commander, command-line adapter and profile shutdown sources form an eight-link path to exit code one.
The retained sentinel_activated then exit-one terminal matches that sufficient source path.
The result does not prove later HMR readiness or measure DeepSeek model/provider performance.
No raw stream was reconstructed and every executable Harness/provider activity count is zero.
unresolved_gates: No inert task has been supplied to a fresh attempt.
Stock-headless HMR readiness after the task-shape correction remains untested.
No runner, broker, worker, model/provider or EMR4 development work is admitted.
Any fresh native proof remains limited to one separately consumed process with no retry.

journey.outcome: One canonical static pass traced the exit to the frozen empty headless task without another Harness or provider process.

current_position.outcome: A one-process provider-free proof will either emit stock_headless_hmr_ready or fail closed at a new sanitized coordinate with complete cleanup.

current_position.orientation_statement: Freeze one fresh provider-free process with exactly one inert task, keep the headless runner disabled, and terminate after stock HMR readiness or the first sanitized failure coordinate.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A unique causal coordinate and a repeated helper-presence predicate must use distinct cardinality rules.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first predicate required forceExitOnce(code) to appear exactly once even though the exact shutdown source invokes it from several branches.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The first focused pytest run failed closed before canonical evidence generation.

correction.action: Require at least one exact helper call while retaining uniqueness only for the causal source-chain verdict.
correction.prevention_control: Static predicates declare whether a token is unique, ordered or merely present before choosing a count operator.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected helper-count predicate and explicit cardinality correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Raw-stream nonretention must be tested structurally without forbidding precise safety prose.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first test prohibited the word stderr anywhere in serialized evidence and therefore rejected the claim boundary that states stderr was not reconstructed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The first focused pytest run failed closed before canonical evidence generation.

correction.action: Assert absence of stream and stderr-digest fields while permitting explicit non-reconstruction prose.
correction.prevention_control: Safety tests inspect schema fields and retained values, not unrestricted vocabulary in explanatory text.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the overbroad vocabulary assertion and structural nonretention correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A widened successor verification packet must exclude assertions intentionally frozen to pre-repair digests and verdicts.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Two widened selections rediscovered four immutable pre-source-repair assertions before the final exact applicability set passed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest reported only expected old controller/sentinel digest and pre-repair verdict mismatches; targeted inspection confirmed their immutable purpose.

correction.action: Name and deselect the four immutable selectors; retain all 37 applicable current and predecessor tests.
correction.prevention_control: Generate and consume an applicability manifest at repair closeout instead of reconstructing negative selectors from memory.
